notes.title: Patch 1.8 is now live!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10390734/d195b0a3751d0bef23e5d333a4b39cb7da801fd3.jpgToday we achieved a huge milestone for this project: we made it out of early access! 

Our goal from the start was to see if we can create an outdoor nature inspired environment and make it immersive enough so it feels like a real world. Turns out that visiting nature in VR has a similar relaxing effect compared to the real thing so if you need a quick escape from the real world: The Grand Canyon VR Experience is waiting for you! 

A big shout-out to our team of awesome developers who did an amazing job creating this unique experience and will continue to maintain and improve this world for you all to enjoy.  I also want to thank the community members who gave us tons of valuable feedback during our early access phase, this was tremendously helpful for us!

Some of the changes include:

    NEW: Some new animals where spotted in the Canyon, can you find them all?
    various environment tweaks.
    added more detail to the world.
    faster loading times.
    various small bug fixes.

As always please use  our bug report forum to help us identify & fix issue as well as leave us suggestions for future improvements and additions!

Happy exploring!

The Immersive Entertainment team.

notes.title: Major new update is Live! (Patch 1.7)
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10390734/a7a84c4053ef5d78efce0f31d59f34c307c6d486.jpg
Hi everyone! 
We just released a major new patch with lots of exciting new changes.
We listened to the feedback of the community and focused our efforts into offering a more polished interactive relaxing kayak ride through the beautiful canyon. We hope you enjoy the rides and are looking forward to your feedback!

TIPS FOR MAXIMUM IMMERSION

 Place a comfy chair in the middle of your play space
 Place an oscillating fan in front of you
 Make the room as dark as possible to avoid unwanted light
 Put on some of your favorite music!


Some of the changes include:

 NEW:Oculus Touch support
 NEW:Completely reworked transparent water
 NEW:Additional animals have been spotted in the canyon
 NEW:Improved rock formations and other environment enhancements
 NEW:Switched the project to forward renderer for much crisper visuals 
 NEW:Choose between two relaxing kayak tours: daytime/nighttime
 NEW:lots of new  HRTF sounds!
    various environment tweaks and fixes
    various small bug fixes.

As always please use  our bug report forum to help us identify & fix issue as well as leave us suggestions for future improvements and additions!

Happy exploring!

The Immersive Entertainment team.

notes.title: Patch 1.62 is now live!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10390734/241c12253ab0eb15343cdae126ea81624be258c2.jpg
Hi everyone! We just released a new patch with plenty of bug fixes and some new features! 

Note about the water shader

We finally were able to identify the bug that is causing the water to flicker under certain angles. It turns out it is an issue deep inside the VR rendering pipeline of Unreal Engine. Epic is working on a fix for us so as soon as they release it we'll issue a hot fix. In the meantime you can cycle between transparent / opaque water with “pagedown”. 

Some of the changes include:

    NEW: Our first of many physics props is enabled => you can now throw, drag, push, move & hurl some small rocks around in the world.
 NEW: HRTF fly, you can't see it, but boy you sure can hear it! 
 NEW: The pier : ideal for hopping on and off the paddle board!
 NEW:Self-driving kayak tours is now also available for Vive users (sit down on the floor in front of a fan for maximum immersion!). 
 NEW: Oculus users can now also teleport to various destinations in the world.
    various environment tweaks.
    you should now find a "chill area" at most hotspots that line up with a typical desk chair height -> move your real life chair into position so it lines up with a virtual rock, chair, pier. Take a seat and let the chilling commence...
    lots of new sounds!
    We tweaked the paddling physics based on your feedback.
    F key displays frame-rate .
    various small bug fixes.

As always please use  our bug report forum to help us identify & fix issue as well as leave us suggestions for future improvements and additions!

Happy exploring!

The Immersive Entertainment team.

notes.title: Patch 1.61 is now live
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We just released patch 1.61, adding gamepad/keyboard support & various bugfixes:

Patchnotes

    Fixed an issue where some users couldn't load the application
    Added gamepad & keyboard support for the self driving kayak tour (see below)
    Some minor performance improvements for low & medium setting
    Some minor bugfixes


Gamepad & keyboard controls :

Enter Kayak : P or A button
Enter Campsite: O or B button
Recenter: ENTER or Back Button 
Flashlight: Left Ctrl or Y 
Speed up: Triggers or W/S or Up arrow/Down arrow


We also started working on the next big content update, so stay tuned for more cool stuff in the coming months!

The Immersive Entertainment team.

notes.title: June content update is now live!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10390734/189f7a5890fa8937a7a7c99f57159aa822abc3bd.jpg
Hi everyone! We just released the June content update. This is a large update with lots of improvements and new features. 

NOTE ON PERFORMANCE :
As you all know VR is very performance hungry so building a large living world like this is not an easy task. There is still a lot of room for performance improvements (especially for the Vive) so the [high] and [epic] graphic settings are highly experimental. 
However, with [space] you can bring up a menu to tweak various graphic settings to your liking: 

Key                    Function
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
1                        low graphics
2                        medium graphics
3                        high graphics
4                        epic graphics 

insert                 no anti-aliasing
home                 FXAA
pageup              temporal
--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Some of the changes include: 


    New starting point : campsite
    BasicTruesky integration with realtime volumetric clouds
    HRTF dynamic insect sounds added
    Binaural wind gusts generator added
    Much more environment variety added

    [Vive]Completely revamped physics based paddling system
    [Vive]Free roaming, go explore!   
    [Vive]First hotspots are placed in the map
    [Vive]Motion-controller driven inventory system
    [Vive]New tool : the scanner
    [Vive]Hop on and off the paddle board

    [Oculus]full remote support to control kayak, speed, flashlight and teleport from campsite to the tour kayak.
    various  bug fixes


Known issues:


      If you paddle with two paddles at the same time, only one will rumble
      Using the flashlight at daytime reduces performance
      If you get stuck with the paddle board please let us know where so we  can fix it. Holding down the grip buttons on both controllers teleports you back to the campsite
      Vive users can hit 
 to jump into the tour kayak if you don't want to paddle (we will have a more elegant solution for this soon)


Also we encountered a bug that makes our cool translucent water flicker at certain angles, we are working with Epic to roll out a fix in the coming weeks. In the meantime we changed the water to a more basic opaque version but you can toggle between the two with [pagedown].

We need your help!

We would love your help finding bugs and providing feedback to continue developing this title and make it as good as we can, if you want to participate in the development process you can do so by sending the bugs you found & any suggestions you have to support@immersiveent.com

Happy Exploring!

The Immersive Entertainment team.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.051
notes.content:
HI everybody, we pushed out a quick hot-fix that squashes a bug causing certain people to have unresponsive game pad / keyboard controls since the upgrade to Oculus run-time 1.3. If you still have issues with the game pad, you can use the following keyboard commands to change the speed of the kayak:


    arrow up/down : change kayak speed (alternative : w/s)
    space : reset orientation 


Happy kayaking!

notes.title: HTC Vive now supported!
notes.content:
We just updated The Grand Canyon VR Experience to version 1.05 and are proud to announce full HTC Vive support!

HTC Vive owners will be able to explore the Grand Canyon using a unique stand-up paddleboarding mode using the motion controllers to paddle yourself forward! Try it standing up, sitting down or even lying down on the board!

Full patch notes [1.05]: 


    NEW: HTC Vive stand-up paddleboarding mode
    NEW: Interaction : use a paddle to move forward, the faster you paddle the faster you move
    NEW: Red Vive wand button switches between the available interaction tools
    NEW: Interaction tool 1 : use the motion controller to throw breadcrumbs in the water -> hold down touchpad, swing your arm, release touchpad to release the breadcrumb
    NEW: Interaction tool 2 : Flashlight, best used when dark! ;)  (touchpad to switch 
on/off)
NEW: Completely revamped quality settings system : please experiment & find the best setting for your PC setup
    various performance enhancements. Make sure you use the latest SteamVR / Oculus Runtime 0.8 / Graphic card drivers (see below)
    various small bug fixes
    some minor environment tweaks


As always please let us know if you encounter any bugs on the  Discussion Board , we welcome everyone's feedback to make this as immersive as possible!

Recommended drivers:
SteamVR  : latest beta release
Oculus : 0.8 runtime  https://developer.oculus.com/downloads/pc/0.8.0.0-beta/Oculus_Runtime_for_Windows/
Nvidia GPU’s : Driver 359.00 or later 
AMD GPU’s : LiquidVR drivers http://support.amd.com/en-us/kb-articles/Pages/Oculus07SDK-Driver.aspx
